import requests
import numpy as np
from osgeo import gdal, osr
import os
import time

output_path = "/opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/rasters/raw/soil_soilgrids_250m_raw.tif"

# AOI bounds with buffer
west, south, east, north = -81.15, 38.20, -80.85, 38.45

# Create a coarser grid for API queries (to stay within rate limits)
# Then we'll interpolate
res = 0.01  # ~1km sampling for API

lons = np.arange(west, east + res, res)
lats = np.arange(north, south - res, -res)  # North to south

print(f"Querying {len(lons)} x {len(lats)} = {len(lons)*len(lats)} points from SoilGrids API")

# Collect data
data = np.full((len(lats), len(lons)), -9999.0, dtype=np.float32)

for i, lat in enumerate(lats):
    for j, lon in enumerate(lons):
        try:
            url = f"https://rest.isric.org/soilgrids/v2.0/properties/query?lon={lon:.4f}&lat={lat:.4f}&property=soc&depth=0-5cm&value=mean"
            resp = requests.get(url, timeout=15)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                result = resp.json()
                value = result['properties']['layers'][0]['depths'][0]['values'].get('mean')
                if value is not None:
                    data[i, j] = float(value)
            time.sleep(0.1)  # Rate limiting
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error at {lon}, {lat}: {e}")
    print(f"Row {i+1}/{len(lats)} complete")

print(f"\nData stats: min={np.min(data[data>0])}, max={np.max(data)}, valid={np.sum(data>0)}")

band.WriteArray(data)
band.SetNoDataValue(-9999)
